method: Manual review of four post-fix browser captures

captures.finding: Plan page reached through the sidebar retains horizontal tabs, full two-column form and repair controls. The inherited priority editor was opened, edited, previewed and closed before this normal-state capture.
Growth import opens over the inherited growth page and uses the complete growth-rules business title.
English navigation, title, actions, item table and original controls are consistent after a language switch.
Mobile growth page remains in the formal host, exposes both actions, wraps tabs cleanly and has no document-level horizontal overflow.

scope_limit: Local static design only; no production navigation, API, encryption, database, or real configuration behavior was tested.
priority_editor_note: The editor is an inherited non-modal open dialog in both baseline and R2; exact comparison is recorded separately and R2 does not restyle it.
